title: Recorded UK imports: poultry meat (HS 0207)
coverage: UK recorded imports from all partners (EU and non-EU import flows); GB and Northern Ireland

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.source: 16 queries over consecutive runs of the basket's CN8 codes (at most ten codes per query), first: https://api.uktradeinfo.com/OTS?$apply=filter(MonthId%20ge%20201901%20and%20(FlowTypeId%20eq%201%20or%20FlowTypeId%20eq%203)%20and%20(CommodityId%20eq%202071110%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071130%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071190%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071210%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071290%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071310%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071320%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071330%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071340%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202071350))/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId,CountryId,CommodityId,SuppressionIndex),aggregate(NetMass%20with%20sum%20as%20SumNetMass,Value%20with%20sum%20as%20SumValue,$count%20as%20Rows))
